page.layout: One page of text, with a page number at the top right. Above the title there is a faint, partly legible line that may be a running head. main_text.l: PRasens[?] hoc canticum Deum ipsum agnoscit auctorem, qui illud, ut populo
apparatu ex ore Dei exceptum non tantum juxta arcam
foederis repositum, sed etiam pentateucho insertum fuit, quo
saepius legere, & memoriae suae altius imprimere
MOses circa divinum illud dictamen se passim
gessit cum Josuâ Dei amanuensem, ex ore Dei illud nunquam non venerandum oraculum conscribentem:

page.notes: The running head at the top, faint and partly covered by show-through, could not be read reliably and is left out. The opening word "PRasens" is partly hidden by the large initial P; the reading is doubtful. The heading "conspicienaus" is doubtful. The strip at the far left edge (fragments such as "laborem", "enit.", "re Pro-", "agisque", "gmata", "R I-") belongs to the neighbouring page and was not transcribed.
